title: Comparative Analysis of Agent Evaluation Frameworks: Stability, Detection, and Discovery in Enterprise Analytics Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.14493v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deploying LLM-based analytics agents in enterprise settings requires evaluation frameworks that can reliably detect failures across complex, multi-tool workflows. We present a three-phase comparative study of three evaluation frameworks, each representing a distinct evaluation paradigm (trace-based LLM judging, text-only LLM judging with red-teaming, and deterministic heuristics), applied to two analytics agents in a controlled research setting using frozen execution traces. Phase 1 quantifies evaluation harness stability through repeated measurements, finding that 97% of configurations meet the stability threshold and that stability patterns are agent-independent. Phase 2 measures known risk detection on 72 ground-truth test cases, where the trace-based framework achieves the best precision-recall balance (F1=0.90) while text-only evaluation matches on recall but generates 5x more false alarms. Phase 3 evaluates unknown risk discovery,

translated_title: 智能体评估框架的比较分析：企业分析智能体中的稳定性、检测与发现
translated_abstract: 在企业环境中部署基于LLM的分析智能体，需要能够可靠检测复杂多工具工作流中故障的评估框架。我们提出了一项针对三种评估框架的三阶段比较研究，每种框架代表一种不同的评估范式（基于轨迹的LLM评判、结合红队测试的纯文本LLM评判、以及确定性启发式方法），并在受控研究环境中使用冻结的执行轨迹应用于两个分析智能体。第一阶段通过重复测量量化了评估框架的稳定性，发现97%的配置达到了稳定性阈值，且稳定性模式与智能体本身无关。第二阶段在72个真值测试用例上测量已知风险的检测能力，其中基于轨迹的框架实现了最佳的精确率-召回率平衡（F1=0.90），而纯文本评估在召回率上持平，但产生的误报多出5倍。第三阶段评估未知风险的发现能力，
tldr: 该论文通过三阶段比较研究系统评估了三种企业分析智能体评估框架，发现基于轨迹的LLM评判框架在评估稳定性（97%配置达标）和已知风险检测（F1=0.90）方面综合表现最佳。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a three-phase comparative study of three evaluation paradigms for enterprise analytics agents, finding that trace-based LLM judging achieves the best overall performance in evaluation stability (97% of configurations stable) and known risk detection (F1=0.90).
